task.description:
Execute docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md's full procedure (steps 1-10) on branch feature/WF03-ISS0439-20260904, currently checked out with all Steps 1/2/3/5 already committed on it. This run touches ONLY docs/issues/, lib/letflow/design/, docs/migration/decisions/, and handoffs/ -- no lib/letflow/ implementation code, no priv/repo/migrations/, no web/. Despite that, this run is NOT exempt from the git wrapper the way WF-01 is: WF-01's exemption applies only to docs/requirements.yaml-only runs; this run also writes a genuine design-exploration artefact and decision record, which is exactly the same file-shape CODE-DESIGNER/CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR/REVIEWER already gated it through, so route it through the full GIT_MERGE procedure rather than a shortcut.

Run steps 5d's mix format/mix compile/mix test checks as normal even though this branch's own diff is docs-only -- the rebase could still surface an unrelated pre-existing failure, and GIT_MERGE.md's own attribution rule applies regardless of what this branch itself changed. Per this project's OWN new rule (added today, ISS-0467/PR #902): under NO circumstances push directly to main, even for a doc-only or one-file change -- always feature branch -> PR -> gh pr merge. You already know this; it is restated here because this run's own diff is unusually small and that is exactly the shape ISS-0467 was filed against.

Use --title "docs: ISS-0439 1C-taxonomy design exploration, deferral recorded as decision 0019 [WF03-ISS0439-20260904]" for the PR (WF-03 branches use the "fix"/"docs" prefix matching the actual change shape; this is a docs change, not a fix, so "docs:" is the more accurate prefix -- use your judgement per GIT_MERGE.md step 7's own title guidance if you disagree, but state why in your result if you deviate).
acceptance_criteria: All 10 steps of GIT_MERGE.md's procedure executed and reported
mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, and mix test all run and their results reported with real numbers, not skipped merely because the diff looks docs-only
Any test failure is attributed per core-directives.md's Failure Attribution Is Structural rule before being called non-blocking, never by count-matching

PR opened, merged via gh pr merge (never a direct push to main), and both required CI checks (backend, frontend) confirmed green or the branch-protection --admin override path used with a stated, evidenced attribution -- per GIT_MERGE.md's Precondition section
Local checkout returned to a clean main synced with the merge commit
